responsibility: Declares the TyTy-side representation of trait bounds carried on types. It defines TypeBoundPredicateItem, which names a specific associated item of a bound and can compute its receiver-adjusted type, and TypeBoundsMappings, the reusable container/mixin through which TyTy types store, print, and extend their specified trait bounds.
same_name_distinction: Defines the TyTy-side bound container and bound-item wrapper interfaces for this stem, such as TypeBoundPredicateItem and TypeBoundsMappings; the .cc file contains the actual probing, predicate resolution, substitution, and helper method bodies.
